scripts.verify: npm run prepare:sample && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run verify:security
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run prepare:sample && npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@latest deploy
scripts.cf:deploy:dry: npm run prepare:sample && npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@latest deploy --dry-run
scripts.cf:pages:deploy: npm run prepare:sample && npm run build && cd cloudflare-pages && npx --yes wrangler@latest pages deploy ../dist --project-name security-threat-response-workbench --branch main
